plans.footnote: Use Auto Scroll free up to 500 sessions per calendar month. Every active license key unlocks unlimited Auto Scroll on this browser.

items.q: How does the Free Auto Scroll limit work?
items.a: Free includes 500 Auto Scroll sessions per local calendar month. One session is counted when Auto Scroll successfully starts for a new Play or Record session; pausing, resuming, restarting or changing the reading layout inside that session does not use another. The counter resets when a new calendar month begins. A valid license key makes Auto Scroll unlimited.

Yes. These are early adopter prices and they will increase as we add more premium features. While your subscription stays active without interruption, you keep the price you signed up at; a Lifetime purchase is a one-time payment that is never affected by later price changes.

items.q: What does the Lifetime plan actually cover?
items.a: A single payment for the Pro features, plus every update and premium feature we release for SolPrompter, with no renewal. Lifetime refers to the lifetime of the product, not the lifetime of the purchaser — it lasts for as long as SolPrompter is commercially operated by us. The full terms are in the Billing and Refund Policy.

Yes. Cancel at any time from your account billing settings, or email contact.solplatform@gmail.com. Automatic renewal stops immediately and you keep paid access until the end of the billing period you already paid for.

We offer a voluntary 7-day refund guarantee on your first purchase made directly through SolPrompter, subject to the conditions in the Billing and Refund Policy. Mandatory consumer rights in your country always apply on top of it.
